verdict.rationale: Babylon.js documents its own Inspector for "visual debugging and scene editing", described as a visual scene inspector and runtime analysis tool. That covers the inspector part of the story, but it is framed as a debugging companion rather than the primary level-building environment. The Node Material Editor (shaders), Playground (code) and Sandbox (model viewer) are adjacent tools, not a level editor. Missing for 10: a full visual editor with a viewport as the primary authoring workflow, prefab/scene-composition support, any level-building documentation, and independent hands-on corroboration of editing workflows.
